solution_files.two_fer.nim:
import strformat

proc twoFer*(name = "you"): string =
  fmt"One for {name}, one for me."

exercise_files.two_fer_test.nim:
import unittest
import two_fer

suite "Two Fer":
  test "no name given":
    check twoFer() == "One for you, one for me."

  test "a name given":
    check twoFer("Alice") == "One for Alice, one for me."
